name: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited
summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides various solutions in India and internationally. It operates through the Power Systems, Industrial Systems, Semiconductors, and Others segments. The company offers power and distribution transformers; switchgears, including high and extra-high voltage, medium voltage, power quality, and relays and automation products; motors comprising fractional horse power motors, large industrial machines, low tension motors, and stampings and laminations; and drives and automation products that include variable frequency drives, modular converters, soft starters, and shaft power monitors.
